argv:
$raw=Get-Content -LiteralPath "$own\group-04.raw.txt"
$show=$false
foreach($line in $raw) {if($line -eq 'FILE=apps/desktop/main/lib/app-protocol.js') {$show=$true}; if($show -and $line -match '^apps/web/src/api.js') {break}; if($show){$line}}
'VERIFICATION_PATHS'
$raw | Where-Object {$_ -match '^(bootstrap|scripts|tests|tools)\\' -and $_ -match '(web|desktop|ui|pack|preview|ci)'} | Select-Object -First 55
'API_CONTRACTS'
rg -n 'If-Match|Idempotency|Last-Event|desktop|Authorization|deviceRole|408|409|410|429|resume|sequence' apps/web/src/api.js apps/web/src/hooks.js apps/web/src/v2client.js | Select-Object -First 70
'WORKBENCH_ACTIONS'
$n=0; Get-Content -LiteralPath apps/web/src/workbench.jsx | ForEach-Object {$n++; if($n -ge 450 -and $n -le 565) { '{0}: {1}' -f $n,$_.Substring(0,[Math]::Min($_.Length,250))}}
'ROOT_NAMES'
Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath . -Name
